headline: Standard Chartered Expects Pakistan Central Bank to Lift Rate to 13% by 2027
summary: Standard Chartered projects the State Bank of Pakistan could raise its key policy rate to 13% by June 2027. Sustained double-digit inflation is expected as crude oil prices remain between $90 and $100 per barrel.
why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets benchmark interest rates, influencing borrowing costs, inflation, and sovereign debt dynamics in South Asia.

impacts.name: Pakistan Policy Rate
impacts.why: Standard Chartered projects Pakistan's central bank will hike interest rates to curb oil-driven inflation.
